title: Valid Arrangement of Pairs
goal: Arrange all directed pairs into one continuous edge trail.
strategy: Hierholzer follows unused outgoing edges until stuck, then writes vertices during backtracking. Reversing that postorder splices every excursion into a trail using each pair once.
